rijen.label: woofer→mid 156.7 LR4 · mid→tweeter 2251.4 LR4
rijen.note: The amp-load barrier aimed at the |Z| minimum over 10-20317 Hz, 394 points — the full-band safety grid extended to the measured sweeps' extent with 154 of the gate reference's own points, so the goal covers every band the M-B/|Z| gate judges (A5e.3b), refined with the gate reference's own points inside the cells beside its coarse minimum (E-1, dip refinement 'minimum'), so a dip narrower than one safety-grid cell is read where the gate reads it, through the same reader the M-B/|Z| gate takes its own minimum through. Goal and limit are therefore one question rather than two; where they can still differ is the grid, and that difference is measured against the floor slack rather than assumed away (V33).
